result.title: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
result.summary: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same? CAPTCHAs offer a natural test, since humans solve them through this very loop, clicking and dragging on the screen and adjusting after each result. Yet existing CAPTCHA benchmarks are largely solved and rarely spatial, while spatial benchmarks rarely require action. We therefore present TuringSpace, a synthetic web environment of 125 interactive CAPTCHAs that span five spatial abilities and must be solved through clicks and drags on the screen. Every task is a program that generates new instances with a checker and an oracle, so the tasks also form a scalable training gym. Humans solve 94.1% of the tasks, whereas the best model, GPT-6 Astra, still fails 25.9% of them, and the best open-weight model, Kimi K3, fails 68.0%. Our further analysis shows that most failures come from misreading the screenshot, and that model reasoning rarely corrects a wrong belief but hallucinates evidence to defend it. To test whether such spatial abilities can be learned, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this gym. Its success rate rises from 1.6% to 33.1%, above Kimi K3, and it improves on all seven out-of-distribution benchmarks, including a 9.9-point gain on the real-world indoor videos of VSI-Bench. These results show that grounding spatial intelligence in screen actions exposes what MLLMs lack and offers a scalable way to teach it, with gains that transfer to real-world scenes. We will release TuringSpace to support further study.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 TuringSpace：125 个需点击拖拽交互完成的合成网页 CAPTCHA，覆盖五类空间能力，每道题由程序生成并自带 checker 与 oracle，可作可扩展训练环境；评测显示人类成功率 94.1%，最强模型仍失败 25.9%，失败主因是误读截图，且模型倾向编造证据为错误信念辩护；用该环境微调 Qwen3.5-9B 使成功率由 1.6% 升至 33.1%，并在七个分布外基准上均有提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「动作—观察—修正」交互回路与错误信念不更新、幻觉证据的现象诊断，直接关联 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本与视觉证据筛选问题；但关注屏幕操作与空间判断，未涉及 latent 推理状态生成，自我修正机制与检查器驱动的监督方式可供核查。
